selected: Deployed 2 redundant L3 Core switches in collapsed-core topology
rationale: Collapsed-core topology combines core and distribution functions for campuses < 5,000 endpoints, providing high availability with lower operational complexity.

selected: Sized 18 access switches for SCI (represented as ACC-SCI Stack for deployment)
rationale: Building Science & Engineering Hall (SCI): 650 endpoints with 20% growth buffer require 780 active drops. Using 48-port switches with 4 reserved uplink ports yields 44 usable access ports per switch. Allocated 18 access switch(es) providing 792 total access ports (12 spare ports). Calculated 28 PoE+ wireless access points (24 endpoints per AP). Allocated 1 distribution switch/stack for building aggregation. Aggregated into a representative Catalyst Stack for streamlined Packet Tracer / GNS3 verification.

Standardized VLAN numbering ensures uniform broadcast domain mapping across campus switches and prevents conflicting PVIDs.

selected: Configured Native VLAN 99 as untagged and unused on all trunks
rationale: Setting the native VLAN to an unused ID (VLAN 99) and disallowing default VLAN 1 mitigates 802.1Q double-tagging and VLAN hopping security vulnerabilities.

selected: Restricted trunk links to explicitly allowed VLAN list [10,20,30,40,50,60]
rationale: Explicit allowed-VLAN pruning confines broadcast/multicast traffic strictly to authorized switches, conserving backplane bandwidth.
